scope: Source-capture review of the J1 mechanical interface: the selected right-angle header TE 1-776163-1 (LCSC C596198), its mating plug, the panel interface and the board-thickness requirement. Evidence only: no design file, footprint, model pose or requirement is changed, and no physical fit is claimed.

status_values.SOURCED: Every stated value is bound to a cited, hashed source in this packet or in the existing connector-candidate packet.
status_values.PARTIAL: Some facts are sourced; the item as a whole is not resolved. The unresolved remainder is listed.
status_values.UNRESOLVED: No captured source proves the item. Nothing here may gate or pass work on it.

items.result: Captured TE statements: K1 (current drawing) titles its recommended layout for a 1.57 mm board and gives no thickness range. Superseded AS114 rev G page 6 section 3.9.A states 'The pc board thickness shall be 1.57 mm' with no local tolerance, so rev G page 1's opening NOTE general tolerance applies: +/-0.13 mm unless otherwise specified, i.e. 1.44-1.70 mm under rev G. That is a historical rev G statement only; rev G is superseded and K1 takes priority under rev G's own section 2.3, so it is not a current allowed range and does not accept the pod board. The pod's declared board is 1.6 mm (REQUIREMENTS.md line 59). The current allowed thickness range and board-lock retention at 1.6 mm plus fabrication tolerance are UNRESOLVED.

evidence.figure: RECOMMENDED P.C. BOARD LAYOUT FOR 1.57 THICK P.C. BOARD
evidence.fact: layout titled for a 1.57 mm board; the title is not a toleranced dimension and the sheet gives no board-thickness range. K1's title-block general tolerances are not applied to it here
(3.0-4.0) reference dimension: exposed contact-tail length from the header seating plane to the tail tips. It is not a projection below the board's underside

rev G (14 MAR 11, superseded): 'Unless otherwise specified, dimensions have a tolerance of +/-0.13 and angles have a tolerance of +/-2 degrees' (the rendered page shows an underlined plus, i.e. +/-; pdftotext extracts it as '+')
rev G (superseded): 'The pc board thickness shall be 1.57 mm.' with no local tolerance, so under rev G the page 1 general tolerance of +/-0.13 mm applies; header intended for wave soldering

items.derived_observation: Arithmetic only, not qualification and not a fit claim. Datums: the existing model check (../README.md, 'Model placement and native convention') gives 3.50 mm from the rear support flats, which rest on the PCB top, to the tail tips. The residual projection below the board's underside is therefore 3.50 - 1.57 = 1.93 mm for a 1.57 mm board and 3.50 - 1.60 = 1.90 mm for a 1.60 mm board (rigid header, nominal values). K1 sheet 1 section A-A's (3.0-4.0) is a reference dimension from the header seating plane to the tail tips, not from the board underside, so the 1.90-1.93 mm below-board figures are not comparable to it. Whether K1's seating plane coincides exactly with the model's support flats is not established here, so no conformance of the 3.50 mm model value to that range is claimed either. Board-lock snap engagement on a thicker board and the fabricator's thickness tolerance are not established by any captured source.
